backlog.title: Runaway-loop hard backstops (E22) + drift-nudge bloatHit demotion
backlog.description: Code-only delta making the implementation match the already-written spec (committed in 3ff35059 + 0bcaa814). Adds two independent hard guards to the rewind tool that refuse BEFORE persisting — a per-prompt retry budget (rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt, default 5) and an out-of-band context-fraction stop (rewind.abortContextFraction, default 0.9) — plus the drift-nudge bloatHit demotion (delta-only when delta data exists). Neither guard exists in code today (grep confirmed). All 863 existing tests must stay green. D4 (no new model request) and E13 (never throw) hold throughout.

milestones.title: E22 retry budget + context-fraction stop (the main feature)
milestones.description: The rewind tool refuses before persisting when (a) >= maxRetriesPerPrompt rewinds have re-landed at the latest user message, or (b) the filtered-context estimate is >= abortContextFraction of the window. Both guards run independently of the existing maxDepth guard and never throw (E13). Acceptance = spec/10 §1.10 (a)-(g) and spec/08 E22.

subtasks.title: Add both knobs to interface + defaults + validate
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/004_d3d84055c5b2/architecture/codebase_patterns.md §1. The MulliganConfig.rewind interface is at src/config.ts lines 30-46; DEFAULT_CONFIG.rewind at lines 115-120 (maxDepth:5 is the sibling); the validateConfig rewind block at lines 217-226 uses safeGet(rewindRaw,"<key>") + a coerce/inline check. coerceNumber(field,value,fallback,mustBePositive) at line 319 enforces finite + (>0 or >=0) but NO upper bound — so abortContextFraction CANNOT use it. The highWaterFraction inline check (lines 256-260) is the exact pattern to copy, adapted from (0,1) to (0,1]. warnConfig(field,value) at line 352 logs + never throws. The whole validateConfig body is one try/catch -> structuredClone(DEFAULT_CONFIG) (line 281).
2. INPUT: None (this is the root config subtask). The spec defaults are rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt=5 (integer >= 1) and rewind.abortContextFraction=0.9 (number in (0,1]) per spec/09 §2/§3 (committed 3ff35059).
3. LOGIC: (a) Add `maxRetriesPerPrompt: number;` and `abortContextFraction: number;` to the MulliganConfig.rewind interface (after maxDepth, before requireMutationWarning, matching spec/09 JSON order: maxDepth, maxRetriesPerPrompt, abortContextFraction, requireMutationWarning). (b) Add `maxRetriesPerPrompt: 5,` and `abortContextFraction: 0.9,` to DEFAULT_CONFIG.rewind in the same relative position. (c) In validateConfig rewind block (after the maxDepth line 224), add: `v = safeGet(rewindRaw, "maxRetriesPerPrompt"); if (v !== undefined) { const n = coerceNumber("rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt", v, cfg.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt, true); cfg.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt = Number.isFinite(n) && Math.floor(n) >= 1 ? Math.floor(n) : cfg.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt; }` — coerceNumber(...,true) gives finite > 0, then Math.floor to integer >= 1; if floor < 1, keep default (coerceNumber already warned). Then: `v = safeGet(rewindRaw, "abortContextFraction"); if (v !== undefined) { if (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0 && v <= 1) cfg.rewind.abortContextFraction = v; else warnConfig("rewind.abortContextFraction", v); }` — the `v <= 1` is the CRITICAL difference from highWaterFraction's `v < 1`. (d) Add JSDoc on each interface field citing spec/08 E22 + the default.
4. OUTPUT: A MulliganConfig where cfg.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt and cfg.rewind.abortContextFraction are always valid (integer>=1 and number in (0,1] respectively), consumed by P4.M1.T2.S1 + P4.M1.T2.S2.

subtasks.title: Per-prompt retry budget guard
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/004_d3d84055c5b2/architecture/codebase_patterns.md §2. countRewindMarkers(ctx) (lines 210-230) is the EXACT defensive-scan model to copy: try/catch around ctx.sessionManager.getEntries(), Array.isArray guard, per-entry try/catch, return 0 on any failure. The refusal(reason,granularity) helper (line 171) adds the "Mulligan: refused — <reason>." prefix + trailing period — callers pass the bare reason. The insertion point is after the maxDepth guard (line 399) and before step 5 resolvePreview (line 400). The whole execute body is one try/catch (line 349 -> 449) so a thrown helper becomes a refusal, but the helper MUST be defensive itself (E13 hot-path).
2. INPUT: cfg.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt (integer >= 1, from P4.M1.T1.S1). ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() — the branch entries (type:"message" with role:"user" for prompts; type:"custom" customType:"mulligan:rewind" for rewind markers).
3. LOGIC: Add module-local `function countRetriesAtLatestPrompt(ctx: ExtensionContext): number`. ALGORITHM (the recommended over-approximation that catches the canonical last_turn loop vector, needs no message-list resolution, and passes §1.10 acceptance): try { entries = ctx.sessionManager.getEntries(); } catch { return 0; } if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return 0; walk entries IN ORDER to find the INDEX of the LAST entry that is type:"message" with role:"user" (the latest user message); if none found, return 0 (no prompt -> no budget consumption). Then count entries at index > that index where type==="custom" && customType==="mulligan:rewind" (rewind markers appended after the latest user message = rewinds during this turn that re-land at the prompt). Per-entry access wrapped in try/catch mirroring countRewindMarkers. Document in a code comment that this is a v1 entry-position over-approximation: for last_tool_call_group/checkpoint rewinds it counts a tool-group rewind issued this turn even if its target was a prior turn's group (the spec's intent — arrest the loop — is met; message-list resolution is a future refinement). Then in rewindExecute after the maxDepth guard: `const retries = countRetriesAtLatestPrompt(ctx); if (retries >= config.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt) { return refusal(`hit the per-prompt retry budget (${retries}/${config.rewind.maxRetriesPerPrompt} rewinds re-landing at this prompt). Commit to the current state, ask the human, or use mulligan_shrink instead of rewinding again`, granularity); }`. A zero-hide rewind still counts (do NOT special-case it — it is the canonical loop vector).
4. OUTPUT: The rewind tool refuses with the budget text when retries >= maxRetriesPerPrompt, persisting nothing. countRetriesAtLatestPrompt never throws. Consumed by P4.M1.T3.S1 tests + P4.M1.T2.S3 (which sets the refused-turn flag).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] none — no user-facing/config/API surface change beyond the guard itself; the refusal text IS the agent-facing doc.

subtasks.title: Out-of-band context-fraction stop guard
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/004_d3d84055c5b2/architecture/codebase_patterns.md §3. audit.ts auditExecute step 1-2 (lines 496-524) computes the filtered total: prefer rt.lastFiltered (the filter's cached output) -> estimateTokens(filtered).tokens; else E16 fallback buildContextEntries() -> filterPipeline -> estimateTokens. estimateTokens (from ../tokens.js) is defensive (never throws). The window SIZE is ctx.getContextUsage()?.contextWindow ?? 0 (filter.ts line 326 pattern) — D5 only forbids .tokens, NOT .contextWindow. rt.lastFiltered is the PREVIOUS fire's view mid-turn (stale estimate; acceptable — the guard errs toward firing LATER/under-counting, the safe direction). Do NOT "fix" the staleness by calling getContextUsage().tokens (D5 violation).
2. INPUT: cfg.rewind.abortContextFraction (number in (0,1], from P4.M1.T1.S1). rt = getRuntime(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()) -> rt.lastFiltered (AgentMessage[] | null). ctx.sessionManager.buildContextEntries(). ctx.getContextUsage()?.contextWindow. estimateTokens from ../tokens.js.
3. LOGIC: Add a shared helper (export it so audit can be refactored to call it, preventing divergence): `export function computeFilteredTotal(ctx: ExtensionContext): { totalTokens: number; windowTokens: number }`. Body wrapped in ONE try/catch -> on ANY failure return { totalTokens: 0, windowTokens: 0 } (fail-open sentinel): try { const rt = getRuntime(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()); let filtered; if (Array.isArray(rt.lastFiltered)) filtered = rt.lastFiltered; else { const entries = ctx.sessionManager.buildContextEntries(); filtered = entriesToMessages(entries); } type TM = Parameters<typeof estimateTokens>[0]; const totalTokens = estimateTokens(filtered as unknown as TM).tokens; const usage = ctx.getContextUsage?.(); const windowTokens = (usage?.contextWindow ?? 0); return { totalTokens, windowTokens }; } catch { return { totalTokens: 0, windowTokens: 0 }; }. NOTE: entriesToMessages is currently module-local in audit.ts — either export it from audit.ts OR duplicate the small flatMap logic inline (it is just entries.flatMap(sessionEntryToContextMessages) defensively). Prefer importing/exporting to avoid divergence; if a circular-import risk exists, inline a minimal version. Then in rewindExecute after the retry-budget guard: `const { totalTokens, windowTokens } = computeFilteredTotal(ctx); if (windowTokens > 0 && totalTokens / windowTokens >= config.rewind.abortContextFraction) { const pct = Math.round((totalTokens / windowTokens) * 100); return refusal(`context is at ${pct}% of the window; rewinding will not help. Run mulligan_audit and shrink the largest result`, granularity); }`. The windowTokens > 0 check IS the fail-open: a stale cache / throwing getContextUsage / no model -> windowTokens 0 -> guard SKIPPED (never blocks a rewind). Compute pct only inside the refusal branch (avoid div display when not refusing). Optionally refactor audit.ts auditExecute step 1-2 to call computeFilteredTotal for the totals (low-risk, same numbers) — keep audit's own `filtered` array for its per-message breakdown.
4. OUTPUT: The rewind tool refuses with the context-fraction text when totalTokens/windowTokens >= abortContextFraction AND windowTokens > 0, persisting nothing. computeFilteredTotal never throws and fails open. Consumed by P4.M1.T3.S1 tests.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] none — no user-facing/config/API surface change; the refusal text IS the agent-facing doc. (If audit.ts is refactored, its behavior/numbers are unchanged so no doc impact.)

subtasks.title: Suppress drift nudge for a turn in which a rewind was refused (SHOULD/advisory)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/004_d3d84055c5b2/architecture/codebase_patterns.md §5 + §6. SessionRuntime (src/runtime.ts lines 59-90) holds in-memory fields; aboveHighWater (lines 85-89) is the exact model for a new rewindRefusedTurnIndex: number | null (default null, reset on session_start/clearAll automatically since those wipe the whole map entry — just add the field to the interface + freshRuntime at lines 110-119). filter.ts contextHandler drift-nudge block (lines 290-305) is a single if(...) { messages = injectNudge(...); } — add a conjunct. markers.metric.turnIndex is the latest metric's turn index. This is a SHOULD: if time-boxed, the MUST guards (S1+S2) alone arrest the runaway loop; file this as a follow-up.
2. INPUT: rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex (new field, from this subtask). readMarkers(ctx).metric?.turnIndex (the current turn index) OR rt.lastTurnIndex. The existing refusal(...) paths in rewindExecute (config-disabled, invalid-note, checkpoint-missing, maxDepth, and the new retry-budget/context-fraction refusals from P4.M1.T2.S1/S2).
3. LOGIC: (a) src/runtime.ts: add `rewindRefusedTurnIndex: number | null;` to SessionRuntime interface + `rewindRefusedTurnIndex: null,` to freshRuntime. (b) src/tools/rewind.ts: at the TOP of the catch-all refusal handling OR in EACH refusal(...) call site, set rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex = currentTurnIndex. Cleanest: obtain rt once near step 1 (const rt = getRuntime(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId())) and the currentTurnIndex = readMarkers(ctx).metric?.turnIndex ?? rt.lastTurnIndex ?? null, then in every `return refusal(...)` path set `rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex = currentTurnIndex` BEFORE returning. The two new guards (S1/S2) and the existing guards (maxDepth, E14, E9, E10) all set it. Wrap the read/set defensively (never throw — E13). (c) src/filter.ts: in the drift-nudge if-block (line 290), add a conjunct that skips injection when rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex === markers.metric?.turnIndex. Clear rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex = null when the turn has advanced (markers.metric?.turnIndex !== rt.rewindRefusedTurnIndex on a later fire -> set null). This stops a capped/stuck turn from being poked by the drift nudge.
4. OUTPUT: A refused rewind this turn suppresses the drift nudge for the remainder of that turn; the flag clears when the turn advances. Never throws.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] none — no user-facing/config surface change.
